verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature or open export format. The only exit-related evidence is indirect: the core search library is open source, Orama Cloud's APIs are designed to mirror the open-source APIs so projects can migrate between them, and Cloud can be deployed on your own infrastructure. That gives some path out of the managed service, but it says nothing about getting your data out. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data, open or standard export formats, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of migrating off the platform.
